name: Ward 1
boundary_summary: From NH-48 at the Delhi border, the line follows the state border past Nathupur and the Sikanderpur Ghosi estate to the Aravali hills. It passes Block G of DLF Phase 1 and Silver Oak Apartments, reaches Gurugram-Faridabad Road via Kusum Marg and returns via Golf Course Road, Shankar Chowk and NH-48.

name: Ward 2
boundary_summary: From the Delhi border the line follows NH-48 to Shankar Chowk, then Raghavendra Marg to Gurugram-Faridabad Road. It passes the Bristol Hotel, MG Road Metro and Beverly Park, crosses NH-48 and follows the Sector 17/18 road, Old Delhi Road and Dundahera village perimeter back towards the state border.

name: Ward 3
boundary_summary: The line runs from Shakti Mandir More to the Carterpuri estate at the state border, around Dundahera to Hanuman Mandir Chowk and down Old Delhi Road to Maruti Gate 2. On the return side it passes Krishna Chowk and follows the northern edge of Palam Vihar Extension.

name: Ward 4
boundary_summary: The Delhi-Gurugram railway meets the state border at the starting point. The line follows the Choma and Carterpuri estates along the border, passes Krishna Chowk, then follows Rejangla Road and the Gurgaon village estate line back to the railway.

name: Ward 5
boundary_summary: From the state border the line follows the railway south, then the Sarai Alawardi and Pawala Khusrupur estate boundaries to Dwarka Expressway. The Sector 109/112 road leads to the Delhi border, which closes the ward along Bajghera and Choma.

name: Ward 6
boundary_summary: At the Delhi border the Sector 109/112 road runs southeast to Dwarka Expressway. The outer boundary follows the estates of Dhankot, Kherki Majra, Daultabad and Dharampur, then the Babupur estate and the state border.

name: Ward 7
boundary_summary: From the southern edge of Surat Nagar Phase 1 the line follows the railway to Dron Kunj Apartments and the Sector 9/9B road to Gurugram-Farrukhnagar Road. On the return side it follows Dwarka Expressway, the northern edge of Dhanwapur and Dhanwapur-Bajghera Road.

name: Ward 8
boundary_summary: From Basai Chowk the line follows Shaheed Sukhbir Yadav Marg to the Gurugram-Rewari railway and runs along Sector 9A. Near Enkay Factory it turns onto Basai Road and returns past the Sector 10 government hospital and Alpine Convent School.

name: Ward 9
boundary_summary: From Enkay Factory the line skirts Krishna Nagar to Pataudi Road near the Rotary Club Blood Bank and follows the Kadipur village perimeter. The return passes Basai village, the Gurugram-Farrukhnagar road, Alpine Convent School and Basai Road.

name: Ward 10
boundary_summary: From the Rotary Club Blood Bank on Pataudi Road the line skirts Gandhi Nagar, Shakti Park and Hari Nagar, then follows the highway to Hero Honda Chowk. Shaheed Sukhbir Singh Yadav Marg leads to Captain Umang Bhardwaj Chowk; the Kadipur perimeter and Pataudi Road close the ward.

name: Ward 11
boundary_summary: From Rajiv Chowk follow Sohna Road to Subhash Chowk, then the Sector 38/47 road to Bakhtawar Chowk. The western side passes Hero Honda Chowk, Hari Nagar and the southern edge of Rajiv Colony before returning to NH-48 by Hans Enclave.

name: Ward 12
colonies: South City Blocks I, J, K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and W
boundary_summary: The line runs from Rajiv Chowk via the Medicity junction and Bakhtawar Singh Road to Medicity Hospital. It skirts Greenwood City near Unitech Cyber Park, reaches Subhash Chowk and returns along Sohna Road beside Islampur.

name: Ward 13
boundary_summary: From Rajiv Chowk the boundary takes Civil Lines Road to the new PWD Rest House and follows Bandh Road towards Sector 15 Part 2. The return runs past Mohyal Colony, the Sector 39/32A road and Medicity Hospital to NH-48.

name: Ward 14
boundary_summary: From Bakhtawar Chowk the line follows Netaji Subhash Chand Marg, skirts Greenwood City and reaches the Sector 45/46 road. It returns along Mayfield Garden, Vikas Marg and the Sector 46/47 road.

name: Ward 15
boundary_summary: The southeast edge of Malibu Towne meets the western boundary of Mayfield Garden. On the Sohna Road side the line skirts Badshahpur habitation, passes Vatika Chowk and follows Southern Peripheral Road and the edge of Uppal Southend to CD Chowk.

name: Ward 16
boundary_summary: From Vatika Chowk the line runs west on Southern Peripheral Road to Baba Jaharvir Goga Ji Chowk and follows the edge of Begumpur Khatola habitation. It crosses Badshahpur Drain on the Teekri side and returns past CD Chowk and Uppal Southend.

name: Ward 17
boundary_summary: The line follows the 30-metre road towards Begumpur Khatola and the edge of its habitation towards Sector 35. On the Pataudi Road side it passes Prachin Hanuman Mandir, the Gadauli Khurd village perimeter and Badshahpur Drain, then returns along Pace City and Khandsa.

name: Ward 18
boundary_summary: From Vatika Chowk the boundary follows Sohna Road and the Badshahpur estate near Hanuman Mandir. It follows the Noorpur Jharsa and Palra estates on the return side, then the Sector 75/70 road and Southern Peripheral Road.

name: Ward 19
boundary_summary: From the southwest corner of the Kadarpur estate on the Badshahpur-Sohna constituency boundary the line runs southeast to the municipal limit. It returns along the Badshahpur and Bhondsi estates via Bhoop Nagar Colony and the Dhumaspur junction.

name: Ward 20
boundary_summary: From the southwest corner of Kadarpur the line follows the eastern edges of Maidawas and Nangli Umarpur. Its outer side reaches the Delhi border at Gwal Pahari and Haidarpur Viran, passes the Gurugram-Faridabad toll plaza and returns along Bandhwari, Behrampur and Kadarpur.

name: Ward 21
boundary_summary: From Arihant Hospital the line takes the Sector 45/52 and 44/52 roads to Ardee City, then St Thomas Marg and the edge of Sushant Lok Block E. It returns from Southern Peripheral Road along the Tigra and Wazirabad estates and Indira Colony.

name: Ward 22
colonies: Sushant Lok Phase 1 Blocks A and B
boundary_summary: From HUDA City Centre the line follows August Kranti Marg to Laburnum. The Golf Course Road side reaches South Point Mall; the return passes the DLF Phase 5 boundary, Paras Hospital and Vyapar Kendra before following the Sector 43/27 road.

name: Ward 23
boundary_summary: From behind the Bristol Hotel the line follows Gurugram-Faridabad Road past Qutub Plaza and the western edge of Silver Oak Apartments. The return passes Golf Course Road, Galleria Market Road, DLF Phase 4 and Maruti Vihar before reaching the Sikanderpur Ghosi estate.

name: Ward 24
boundary_summary: From HUDA City Centre the line takes the Sector 43/27 road and skirts Sushant Lok towards Paras Hospital. On the return side it skirts Maruti Vihar and Laburnum, then takes August Kranti Marg along the Sector 29/28 and 29/27 divisions.

name: Ward 25
boundary_summary: From the Sector 17/18 junction the boundary follows NH-8 south to Signature Tower 2 and skirts Patel Nagar. On its return it passes Jyotiba Phule Chowk, Sector 12 Road and Old Delhi Road before turning onto the Sector 17/18 road.

name: Ward 26
colonies: Sheetla Colony Blocks A and B
boundary_summary: From Lt Atul Kataria Chowk follow Old Delhi Road to Chaupal Hotel and Sector 12 Road to Jyotiba Phule Chowk. The line passes the Roadways Workshop and Mianwali Colony, then returns via Sector 12A Road, Sheetla Mata Mandir and CRPF Camp Chowk.

name: Ward 27
boundary_summary: Starting at Rajiv Chowk on NH-48, the line skirts Shanti Nagar and Shivaji Nagar to the police commissioner's office. It returns via Bus Stand Road, Maharaja Agrasen Chowk, Patel Nagar, Jharsa Bandh and the new PWD Rest House.

name: Ward 28
boundary_summary: From the Rotary Club Blood Bank the line reaches the police post on Pataudi Road along the constituency boundary. It crosses NH-48 on Berywala Bag Road and returns along the edges of Rajeev Colony, Hari Nagar, Shakti Park and Gandhi Nagar.

name: Ward 29
boundary_summary: From Enkay Factory on Basai Road the line skirts Feroz Gandhi Colony 1 and Nai Abadi to Sethi Hospital and Bhuteshwar Mandir Chowk. The return passes DAV School on Khandsa Road, the Pataudi Road police post and the northwest edge of Amar Colony.

name: Ward 30
boundary_summary: From New Colony More the line takes Old Railway Road past Prem Mandir to Madanpuri Gali 1. It skirts Arjun Nagar and Madanpuri, passes Jyoti Park Gali 7 and Geeta Bhawan Mandir and returns along Main Madanpuri Road.

name: Ward 31
boundary_summary: From Chintpurni Mata Mandir Chowk the line follows the Dayanand Colony edge on Sector 5 Road and skirts Gurgaon village habitation. It returns by Prem Mandir, New Colony More and the edge of Rattan Garden near Aryan Hospital on Old Railway Road.

name: Ward 32
boundary_summary: From Sector 4/7 Chowk the line follows Old Railway Road to Aryan Hospital and skirts Shivpuri and New Colony towards Geeta Bhawan Mandir Road. It passes Jyoti Park West and Housing Board, then returns from ESI Hospital via Surya Vihar and Sector 9 Chowk.

name: Ward 33
boundary_summary: From Sector 4/7 Chowk follow the dividing road to Sector 9 Chowk, then the Sector 4/9 road to the railway at the edge of Laxman Vihar Phase 2. Follow the railway along Laxman Vihar and return on New Railway Road.

name: Ward 34
boundary_summary: The schedule traces the railway side of Surat Nagar Phase 1, the southern limits of Sarai Alawardi and Pawala Khusrupur and Dwarka Expressway beside Daultabad. It returns via the Gurugram-Dhanwapur-Tikampur estate junction and Dhanwapur-Bajghera Road.

name: Ward 35
boundary_summary: The schedule names the edge of Surat Nagar Phase 1 and Dhanwapur Road near Godrej Summit. It follows the Gurgaon-Dhanwapur-Tikampur estate junction, the Northern Peripheral Road at Daultabad and the southern limits of Pawala Khusrupur and Sarai Alawardi.

name: Ward 36
boundary_summary: From Lt Atul Kataria Chowk the line follows Sheetla Mata Road to CRPF Camp Chowk, skirts Sheetla Colony Blocks A and B and Gurgaon village habitation, then reaches the railway beside Bhimgarh Kheri and Ashok Vihar 2. It returns via Krishna Chowk, Gaushala Road, the Carterpuri and Inayatpur estate lines, Maruti Gate 2 and Old Delhi Road.
